issues.text: Facts of the task checked before building on them: the starter as built (read as text: stateEnv, homeDir, the messages of 4.1, the precedence, checkedScript by the reason text, L3: the 'inside the repository' message names the real path, so E2S-22 asserts it on a path with no link), the stand-in (15 modes, the guard 'strictly under' its real temporary root, the env event with home), the tag's counts (20/211 and 52/535, as design F28), and after sub-step 3 the kit files are 74 of 74 as the task says. The step-02 handoff's EXPECTED_RED E2S-01, 03, 05 are fixed here by section 11.1.

Design section 16 says P06b (the hook does not mask) is red in HK-22, HK-23, MK-01, MK-03, MK-02. My P06b removes only the hook's masking of the task description (protocol.js buildWriteBody); with it MK-01, MK-03 and MK-02 are red, HK-22 and HK-23 stay green (they check other fields or the prompt text). The spec is green under it, as the design says (defence in depth: the server masks again). The designer's P06b may have removed more; for DOC-UPDATER at step 10, section 16 can name the narrower mutant and its three red tests.

How the product mask mutants turn the spec red: P05 and P33 make 'mask' red at its wait (the mask label never appears on the page, WAIT_TIMEOUT 10000 ms), before the place checks; P34 makes it red at the place 'the stderr of the server holds the key'. The places 'an answer of /api/events' and 'the storage of the origin' have no mutant of their own, as О8 records (no raw text reaches them while the server masks); the answers place has a positive control (an answer holds 'Check [скрыто] now').

Cases added beyond the design's list, each of the class of a listed case (AP-110), none weakening it: E2S-02 every base name, USERPROFILE, null and number stateEnv, the names A-B, empty and 'A B', a list as a value; E2S-03 the root as an argument and after =, a relative env value given as it is, the reason of every refusal asserted, the count 27; E2S-05 a decoy USERPROFILE too, the decoy left empty; E2S-21 the controls of the precedence (the bad exit and the timeout did happen), lstat kinds of the two entries; E2S-22 the script path as a later argument is refused (pins 'the first argument only', own mutant X02); spec: four runHook refusals (both folders x both checks; О18 asked two), EVENTS equal (not 'includes'), exactly one task row, the elapsed time from the end of the hook asserted in live and in reconnect, the lost event absent from the file, the README words of the new row after the restart. Own mutants S09b, R02o, R07b, X01-X07 (11) are red; R04x is a demonstration.
